name: Tan Canh Duong
kicker: The livelier beach north of the bay
summary: Swim the Canh Duong beach north of Lang Co, then stay for the evening grill. This is the livelier shore in the same zone, with bars and a seafood fire, separate from the quiet curve under the pass. No beach ticket is set. Skip it if that quiet morning is the whole point.
getThere: North of the Lang Co strip, in the same zone. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Open sand at Canh Duong, with the mountains across the water

notice.title: The quiet curve is the other shore
notice.body: The long beach under the pass is the other shore. Tân Cảnh Dương is the louder evening, with a grill and a fire on the sand.

body: Swim, then stay into the evening. Tân Cảnh Dương is the beach at thôn Cảnh Dương, in the north of the same tourism zone, and it is a different shore from the long curve under the pass. The water is for the swim. After dark the shore turns to grilled seafood and a fire on the sand, with bars and restaurants along the beach.

Summer is the season for this swim. The fee and the hours are Check on arrival. From Hue the distance is about 60 km south, and also a little over 60 km. Minutes from the Lang Co strip are check on arrival. Skip this beach if the quiet morning under the pass is the whole point.

figures.caption: The same shore under the palms, with people on the sand
figures.alt: Palm shade and people on the sand at Canh Duong beach, with the sea beyond

gettingThere: The beach is at thôn Cảnh Dương, north of the Lang Co strip, in the same tourism zone. Highway 1A is the road toward it. Minutes from the sand at Lang Co are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Lang Co
legs.body: North to thôn Cảnh Dương. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hue
legs.body: South to the coast. The distance is about 60 km, and also a little over 60 km. Drive minutes are check on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. No opening clock is set.
closed: No weekly closing day is set. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: No beach ticket is set. Check on arrival if a gate asks. A meal on the sand is separate from any gate.
